sources.title: GitHub - vegah/LLMNpuTest: Just a test creating a llm kernel for XDNA2
sources.snippet: Part 2 — granite-4.2-3B: the model FastFlowLM cannot run The goal is to get granite running in FastFlowLM. For Qwen above, open kernels were a demonstration — FLM already runs that model and the 1.27x was a bonus. Here they are the only route. FastFlowLM's llama engine whitelists hidden_size to {2048, 3072, 4096} and granite is 2560.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 - IBM
sources.snippet: Granite 4.2 is a family of dense reasoning language models available in three sizes: 3B, 8B, and 30B parameters. Granite 4.2 introduces native reasoning (thinking) capabilities, allowing models to perform step-by-step chain-of-thought reasoning before producing final answers.
